 Yaxel Lendeborg is excited to face Luka Doncic again and reignite their rivalry in Friday’s Lakers-Warriors NBA Cup matchup.

 Lendeborg expressed immense excitement as he will go up against the Slovenian superstar in the Los Angeles Lakers-Golden State Warriors NBA Cup opener on Friday.
 "Absolutely," a smiling Lendeborg said as he was asked if he is looking forward to meeting Doncic and the Lakers. "Absolutely. Yes, I am.
 "I’ll talk about that on Friday."
 Yaxel Lendeborg, Luka Doncic set for a rematch after new rivalry
 Yaxel Lendeborg went toe-to-toe against Luka Doncic to kickstart the 2026-27 NBA season.
 In the season opener between the LA Lakers and the Golden State Warriors last week, the intense face-off between Lendeborg and Doncic made headlines, as both players got heated with trash talking and physical plays.
 Following the Lakers' 127–105 blowout victory against the Warriors, the feud escalated further when Lendeborg told reporters that he "lost all respect" for Doncic due to his constant complaining and foul-baiting on the court.
 Through five games so far this season, Lendeborg is averaging a highly impressive 22.6 points, 9.2 rebounds, and 4.0 assists. He dropped 26 points and nine rebounds as the Warriors won their second consecutive game by beating the Minnesota Timberwolves this Wednesday, 119-114.
 While he is mainly looking forward to facing Doncic, the status of the Slovenian superstar for Friday's NBA Cup opener is yet to be known. Doncic did not play for the Lakers' Wednesday match against the LA Clippers due to back tightness.
